body.content: Fixture cost: The lease-mismatch test can be covered by a minimal fixture that freezes a single lease binding and mutates its drift field, avoiding the need for a full manifest. The seat-binding test may require a slightly more complex fixture to represent the school-to-seat relationship, but it should still avoid rebuilding the entire routing topology.
body.why_keep_this: This note assesses the fixture cost, ensuring the suite adheres to the requirement of avoiding a full manifest where a frozen lease suffices.
